version_tested: not run here: dataretrieval>=1.4 is not installed in the development environment (no installs, no network); the names below follow the USGS announcement of the waterdata module and the OGC API parameters recorded in the aihydro-data fixtures
purpose: dataretrieval.waterdata: the USGS-maintained Python client for the Water Data OGC API. For code the agent writes itself; the aihydro tools use the aihydro-data adapter instead (usgs_waterdata card).

waterdata.get_daily.note: daily values; discharge is parameter_code '00060', mean statistic_id '00003'

waterdata.get_continuous.note: instantaneous values; at most 3 years per query; timestamps are UTC

gotchas: Set API_USGS_PAT (an api.data.gov key) in the environment before heavy use; without a key the service answers HTTP 429 above a few queries per hour.
The legacy dataretrieval.nwis functions call waterservices.usgs.gov, decommissioned on 2027-02-22. Do not use them in new code.
Values arrive as strings and missing values as null: convert and check explicitly.
approval_status (Approved / Provisional) and qualifier are separate fields; keep both with the values.
Discharge is in ft^3/s; convert with 0.028316846592 m^3 per ft^3.
Verify the function and argument names against the installed dataretrieval version before relying on them: this card was not executed.

import os
